mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever the rate is at or below this threshold, which has been the case since the 2008 financial crisis.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% indicates severe labor market distress, triggering a risk-off sentiment that depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 9.0% and industrial production below 90.0 signals a deep recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0 and INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-recession recovery phase, an industrial production level above 90.0 indicates accelerating economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-recession recovery periods when INDPRO > 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly housing starts exceeding 600.0 units signal a strengthening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST > 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a CPIAUCSL reading above 220.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank hawkishness and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL > 220.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production level below 85.0 indicates severe economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 85.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts below 600.0 and retail sales below 340000.0 signal a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 600.0 and RSAFS < 340000.0.
